name: Iwakura Rei
source:
Ren's sister.

[spoiler]The current Rei Iwakura, known as Rei-algo, is an AI-powered interface for the new algo.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Ren's twin sister. She got pregnant from birth incentives, but lost her life due to blood loss from giving birth to a calf.[/spoiler]
